about_zh: 操作系统层面的工具：桌面应用、菜单栏、窗口与文件管理。

repos.description: Open-source Windows and Office activator featuring HWID, Ohook, TSforge, and Online KMS activation methods, along with advanced troubleshooting.
repos.summary_zh: MAS 是一个开源的 Windows 和 Office 激活工具，支持 HWID、Ohook、TSforge 和在线 KMS 等多种激活方式，并提供高级故障排除功能。通过 PowerShell 脚本或传统 CMD 文件一键激活系统，适用于 Windows 8.1/10/11 及 Office 产品，集成自动化与跨平台支持。
repos.summary_en: MAS is an open-source activator for Windows and Office using HWID, Ohook, TSforge, and Online KMS methods, with advanced troubleshooting. It enables one-click activation via PowerShell or CMD scripts, supporting Windows 8.1/10/11 and Office, featuring automation and cross-platform compatibility.

repos.description: A modern GUI client based on Tauri, designed to run in Windows, macOS and Linux for tailored proxy experience
repos.summary_zh: Clash Verge Rev 是基于 Tauri 2 和 Rust 构建的现代化 Clash.Meta 客户端，支持跨平台（Windows/macOS/Linux），提供简洁美观的 GUI 界面、配置文件管理、TUN 模式、WebDav 同步及自定义主题，适用于高性能代理需求。
repos.summary_en: Clash Verge Rev is a modern GUI client for Clash.Meta (mihomo) built with Tauri 2 and Rust, offering cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux), intuitive UI, config management, TUN mode, WebDav sync, and customizable themes for advanced proxy control.

repos.description: A GUI client for Windows, Linux and macOS, support Xray and sing-box and others
repos.summary_zh: v2rayN 是一款跨平台（Windows、Linux、macOS）的图形化客户端，支持 Xray、sing-box 等多种代理核心。提供直观的用户界面，简化了代理配置与管理流程，适用于需要稳定翻墙或网络加速的用户。
repos.summary_en: v2rayN is a cross-platform GUI client for Windows, Linux, and macOS, supporting multiple proxy cores including Xray and sing-box. It offers an intuitive interface to simplify configuration and management of network proxies for enhanced connectivity.

repos.description:  Now we have become very big, Different from the original idea. Collect premium software in various categories.
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Mac 是一个精选 macOS 优质软件的资源库，涵盖开发工具、设计软件、效率应用等多个类别。项目规模庞大，支持多语言（含中文、韩文），并提供 Docker 镜像和 npm 包形式发布。包含开源、免费、App Store 应用等标签分类，鼓励用户贡献与反馈。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Mac is a curated collection of premium macOS software across categories like development tools, design apps, and productivity utilities. It features a vast scale, multilingual support (including Chinese and Korean), and is available via Docker and npm. The list categorizes apps by open-source, freeware, and App Store status, encouraging community contributions.

repos.description: 🐹 Keep your Mac and PC clean, light, and running like new. Fast open-source CLI, plus native Mac and Windows apps.
repos.summary_zh: Mole 是一款 macOS 深度清理优化工具，集成 CleanMyMac、AppCleaner 等工具功能于一身。支持深度清理缓存日志、智能卸载应用及其残留文件、可视化磁盘分析、实时系统监控，并提供一键优化系统服务。通过 Homebrew 或脚本安装，提供交互式菜单与命令行操作，支持预览清理计划、白名单管理及详细调试日志，兼顾高效性与安全性。
repos.summary_en: Mole is a comprehensive macOS optimization tool combining features of CleanMyMac, AppCleaner, DaisyDisk, and iStat Menus. It enables deep cleaning of caches/logs, smart app uninstallation with leftover removal, visual disk analysis, real-time system monitoring, and system service optimization. Installed via Homebrew or script, it offers interactive menus and CLI commands with dry-run previews, whitelist management, and detailed debug logging for safe and efficient system maintenance.

repos.description: Turn any website into a lightweight desktop app with one command, on macOS, Windows and Linux.
repos.summary_zh: Pake 是一个基于 Rust Tauri 框架的网页转桌面应用工具，支持一键将任意网页打包为跨平台（macOS/Windows/Linux）原生应用。核心优势包括体积小巧（仅约5MB）、启动迅速、零配置快速部署，并提供广告过滤、沉浸式模式、快捷键等丰富功能，极大提升网页应用的使用体验。
repos.summary_en: Pake is a lightweight tool that converts any webpage into a desktop app with one command, built on Rust Tauri for cross-platform support (macOS, Windows, Linux). It offers ultra-small size (~5MB), fast startup, zero-configuration packaging, and features like ad-blocking, immersive mode, and customizable shortcuts for enhanced web app usability.

repos.description: :atom: The hackable text editor
repos.summary_zh: Atom 是一款基于 Electron 构建的现代化可定制文本编辑器，专为 21 世纪开发者设计。它融合了经典编辑器的优点，支持深度自定义但默认配置友好易用，适用于跨平台开发环境。
repos.summary_en: Atom is a hackable, modern text editor built on Electron, designed for deep customization while remaining approachable. It combines the best features of traditional editors with a flexible, open-source architecture for developers.

repos.description: 🚀 Awesome list of open source applications for macOS. https://t.me/s/opensourcemacosapps
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是 macOS 开源应用精选列表，收录 689 款高质量开源应用，涵盖音频、开发、图形、生产力等 49 个类别。以 Swift 为主力语言，支持跨平台与原生应用，旨在帮助用户发现优质免费工具并鼓励社区贡献。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates 689 open source macOS applications across 49 categories, including audio, development, graphics, and productivity. Primarily written in Swift, it features both native and cross-platform apps to help users discover free tools and encourages community contributions.

repos.description: UniGetUI: The Graphical Interface for your package managers. Could be terribly described as a package manager manager to manage your package managers
repos.summary_zh: UniGetUI 是 Windows 平台的多合一包管理器图形化界面，支持 WinGet、Scoop、Chocolatey、Pip、Npm 等主流 CLI 工具。Devolutions 收购后强化了企业级安全与维护投入，提供统一界面管理软件安装、更新与卸载，兼顾社区驱动与长期发展。
repos.summary_en: UniGetUI is a graphical interface for popular CLI package managers on Windows, including WinGet, Scoop, Chocolatey, Pip, Npm, and more. Developed by Martí Climent and now stewarded by Devolutions, it offers unified software discovery, installation, update, and uninstallation while ensuring security and enterprise readiness.

repos.description: Lovely console emulator package for Windows
repos.summary_zh: Cmder 是一款专为 Windows 设计的轻量级终端模拟器，基于 ConEmu 深度优化，集成 Monokai 配色、clink 增强命令行及自定义提示符。其核心优势在于完全便携性，无外部依赖，支持 USB 存储或云同步，内置 wget、curl、git 等工具，适合开发者随时随地高效使用命令行环境。
repos.summary_en: Cmder is a portable console emulator for Windows, built on ConEmu with major enhancements including Monokai color scheme, clink integration, and customizable prompts. It offers zero external dependencies, ideal for USB drives or cloud storage, and includes tools like wget, curl, and git for seamless command-line productivity.

repos.description: A cross-platform launcher that simply works
repos.summary_zh: Wox 是一款跨平台启动器，提供快速搜索应用、文件、文件夹及AI聊天功能，支持MCP集成。通过插件系统和主题扩展，用户可用JavaScript或Python开发自定义功能。软件为单文件免安装，兼容Windows/macOS/Linux，快捷键操作高效便捷，是Alfred和Raycast的开源替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Wox is a cross-platform launcher offering fast search for apps, files, and folders, plus AI chat with MCP support. It features a plugin system (JavaScript/Python) and themes, runs as a single executable without installation, and supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. Designed as an open-source alternative to Alfred and Raycast, it emphasizes simplicity and extensibility.

repos.description: MagicMirror² is an open source modular smart mirror platform. With a growing list of installable modules, the MagicMirror² allows you to convert your hallway or bathroom mirror into your personal assistant.
repos.summary_zh: MagicMirror² 是一款开源模块化智能镜平台，可将走廊或浴室镜子转换为个人助手。基于 Electron 构建，无需服务器或浏览器，支持大量可安装插件，提供天气、日历、新闻等实时信息展示，适用于智能家居场景。
repos.summary_en: MagicMirror² is an open source modular smart mirror platform that transforms hallways or bathroom mirrors into personal assistants. Built with Electron, it requires no web server or browser, supports numerous installable modules for displaying real-time info like weather, calendar, and news in smart home environments.

repos.description: Bring macOS “Quick Look” feature to Windows
repos.summary_zh: QuickLook 是一款为 Windows 系统移植的 macOS ‘快速查看’ 功能工具，支持通过空格键即时预览文件内容，涵盖图片、文档、视频等多种格式。其核心优势在于轻量化设计、低资源占用和高度可扩展性，用户可通过插件系统自定义预览功能，极大提升文件浏览效率。
repos.summary_en: QuickLook brings macOS 'Quick Look' functionality to Windows, enabling instant file previews by pressing the spacebar. It supports diverse file types including images, documents, and videos with minimal resource usage and extensibility via plugins, significantly enhancing file browsing efficiency.

repos.description: Apple TV Aerial Screensaver for Mac
repos.summary_zh: Aerial 是一款 macOS 屏保程序，基于 Apple TV 的 Aerial 系列航拍视频，展示纽约、旧金山、夏威夷、中国等地的壮丽景色。支持多语言地理特征标注、实时天气与预报，开源协作，兼容 Apple Silicon。
repos.summary_en: Aerial is a macOS screensaver featuring Apple's Aerial video collection, showcasing aerial views of locations like New York, San Francisco, and Hawaii. It supports multilingual overlays, real-time weather data, and is open-source with community contributions.

repos.description: 🐱 跨平台互动桌宠 BongoCat，为桌面增添乐趣！
repos.summary_zh: BongoCat 是一款跨平台互动桌宠应用，基于 Tauri 框架开发，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 系统。它以可爱的猫咪形象提供桌面陪伴功能，用户可通过点击、拖拽等交互触发趣味动画，为日常办公增添轻松娱乐元素。
repos.summary_en: BongoCat is a cross-platform interactive desktop pet built with Tauri, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. It features a playful cat character that responds to user interactions like clicks and drags with animated effects, adding entertainment to your desktop experience.

repos.description: Lightweight clipboard manager for macOS
repos.summary_zh: Maccy 是一款轻量级 macOS 剪贴板管理器，支持历史记录保存、快速搜索与检索，提供键盘优先操作体验。具备原生界面、隐私安全、开源免费等特性，支持快捷键复制/粘贴、忽略特定应用、自定义过滤规则等高级功能，适用于高效文本管理与重复内容复用场景。
repos.summary_en: Maccy is a lightweight clipboard manager for macOS that preserves copy history with fast search and retrieval. It emphasizes keyboard-first interaction, native UI, privacy, and open-source design. Features include smart filtering, hotkey-based actions, and customizable ignore rules for enhanced productivity.

repos.description: Streaming music player that finds free music for you
repos.summary_zh: Nuclear 是一款免费开源的跨平台音乐播放器，支持无广告、无追踪的音乐流媒体播放。它通过插件系统聚合多源音乐资源，提供强大的搜索、播放列表管理、主题定制及 AI 智能体驱动功能（MCP 协议），并内置插件商店和自动更新机制。
repos.summary_en: Nuclear is a free, open-source music player that streams music without ads or tracking. It aggregates music from multiple sources via a plugin system, offering advanced features like search, playlists, themes, and AI agent control through the MCP protocol, with built-in auto-updates and cross-platform support.

repos.description: 收集&推荐优秀的 Apps/硬件/技巧/周边等
repos.summary_zh: Best App 是一个精选优质应用、硬件及生活技巧的推荐项目，涵盖 macOS、iOS、Android 等平台。聚焦付费与免费精品应用，提供详细功能介绍与横向测评，帮助用户高效选择提升效率与幸福感的工具。项目强调客观推荐，拒绝广告与捐赠，倡导有章可循的产品选择。
repos.summary_en: Best App is a curated collection of excellent apps, hardware, and life-enhancing tips across macOS, iOS, and Android. It features detailed reviews and comparisons of premium and free apps, helping users make informed choices for productivity and lifestyle improvement. The project maintains objectivity, avoids ads, and encourages community contributions via Star or Pull Request.

repos.description: Open source Loom alternative. Beautiful, shareable screen recordings.
repos.summary_zh: Cap 是一款开源的 Loom 替代工具，提供美观、可分享的屏幕录制功能。支持视频录制、编辑与快速分享，采用 Rust + Tauri 构建桌面端，Next.js + React 开发 Web 端，基于 MySQL 和 Drizzle ORM，支持 Docker 一键部署与自托管。
repos.summary_en: Cap is an open-source alternative to Loom, offering beautiful, shareable screen recordings. It enables quick video recording, editing, and sharing via a desktop app (Tauri/Rust) and web interface (Next.js/React), with MySQL backend, Docker deployment, and self-hosting support.

repos.description: 🌈一个跨平台的划词翻译和OCR软件 | A cross-platform software for text translation and recognition.
repos.summary_zh: Pot 是一款跨平台划词翻译与 OCR 软件，支持 Windows/macOS/Linux 及 Wayland 环境，集成 OpenAI、Google、DeepL 等 20+ 翻译接口，提供多接口并行翻译、语音合成、生词本导出等功能，具备插件系统和外部调用能力，界面简洁高效。
repos.summary_en: Pot is a cross-platform software for text translation and OCR, supporting Windows/macOS/Linux and Wayland. It integrates 20+ translation APIs including OpenAI, Google, and DeepL, offering parallel translation, speech synthesis, vocabulary export, plugin system, and external call functionality with a clean interface.

repos.description: This repository is outdated and new Boost Note app is available! We've launched a new Boost Note app which supports real-time collaborative writing. https://github.com/BoostIO/BoostNote-App
repos.summary_zh: BoostNote-Legacy 是一款面向程序员的开源笔记应用，支持多平台（Mac、Windows、Linux）。该仓库已标记为过时，推荐使用支持实时协作的新版 BoostNote 应用，其基于 Electron、React + Redux 构建，提供跨平台桌面与移动端支持。
repos.summary_en: BoostNote-Legacy is an open-source note-taking app designed for programmers, supporting Mac, Windows, and Linux. This repository is deprecated; users are advised to migrate to the new BoostNote app, which features real-time collaborative writing and is built with Electron, React + Redux.

repos.description: :speech_balloon: A better WeChat on macOS and Linux. Built with Electron by Zhongyi Tong.
repos.summary_zh: Electronic WeChat 是一款基于 Electron 开发的跨平台微信客户端，专为 macOS 和 Linux 设计。它复刻了网页版微信的所有功能，包括消息撤回拦截、表情包支持、拖拽发送图片等，并优化了原生应用体验。项目已停止维护，但作为 Electron 桌面应用开发的优秀范例仍具参考价值。
repos.summary_en: Electronic WeChat is an Electron-based cross-platform WeChat client for macOS and Linux, replicating all Web WeChat features including message recall blocking and sticker support. It offers native-like experience with optimizations like direct URL access and drag-and-drop file sharing. Though discontinued, it serves as an excellent reference for Electron desktop app development.

repos.description: :speech_balloon: A better WeChat on macOS and Linux. Built with Electron by Zhongyi Tong.
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 Electron 开发的跨平台微信客户端，支持 macOS 和 Linux，提供现代化界面和完整 Web 微信功能，包括消息撤回拦截、贴图支持、文件拖拽发送等。项目已停止维护，作为技术存档供学习参考。
repos.summary_en: An Electron-based cross-platform WeChat client for macOS and Linux, featuring modern UI, full Web WeChat functionality, message recall blocking, sticker support, and drag-and-drop file sharing. The project is archived and no longer actively maintained.

repos.description: :metal: A collection of Alfred 3 and 4 workflows that will rock your world
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供一系列 Alfred 3/4 工作流工具，涵盖系统休眠控制、浏览器兼容性查询、色彩格式转换、开发文档检索、域名搜索及表情符号查找等实用功能，通过快捷键快速调用，显著提升 macOS 开发者和效率用户的日常操作体验。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers a curated collection of Alfred 3/4 workflows for macOS, including system sleep control, browser compatibility checks, color format conversion, developer documentation search, domain lookup, and emoji search, all accessible via keyboard shortcuts to boost productivity.

repos.description: 收集整理远程工作相关的资料
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库系统整理远程工作相关资源，涵盖文章、问题解答、团队案例、视频播客、工具站点等，聚焦中国受众，提供远程办公经验分享、招聘信息、协作工具推荐及行业报告，助力远程工作者获取实用信息与职业发展支持。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates comprehensive resources on remote work, including articles, Q&A, team cases, videos, podcasts, tools, and reports, primarily targeting Chinese audiences. It offers practical guidance on remote work, job opportunities, collaboration tools, and industry insights to support freelancers and remote professionals.

repos.description: [deprecated in favor of https://microsoft.github.io/react-native-windows/] React Native for macOS is an experimental fork for writing desktop apps using Cocoa
repos.summary_zh: React Native macOS 是一个实验性分支，允许使用 React Native 和 Cocoa 构建 macOS 桌面应用。该项目已停止维护，推荐迁移至微软官方支持的 React Native Windows 或利用 Catalyst 技术运行。
repos.summary_en: React Native for macOS was an experimental fork enabling desktop app development using React Native and Cocoa. The project is now deprecated and no longer maintained, with Microsoft's React Native Windows recommended as the successor.

repos.description: Lightweight real-time memory management application to monitor and clean system memory on your computer.
repos.summary_zh: Mem Reduct 是一款轻量级实时内存管理工具，通过调用 Windows 原生 API 清理系统缓存（工作集、备用页列表等），显著释放闲置内存，兼容 Win7+ 64位/ARM64 系统，需管理员权限运行，支持便携模式与 GPG 签名验证。
repos.summary_en: Mem Reduct is a lightweight real-time memory management tool that monitors and cleans system memory by leveraging undocumented Native APIs to clear cache (working set, standby pages). It supports Windows 7+ 64-bit/ARM64, requires admin rights, offers portable mode, and includes GPG-signed binaries for security.

repos.description: 网易云音乐第三方
repos.summary_zh: ieaseMusic 是一款基于 Electron、React 和 MobX 构建的优雅网易云音乐第三方桌面客户端，支持跨平台（macOS/Linux/Windows）、高音质（FLAC）、键盘操作、桌面通知、Last.fm 听歌记录同步、多平台音源修复（如 QQ 音乐、虾米等）、社交分享及微信扫码登录，集成 Alfred 3 工作流，提供现代化 UI 与下载功能。
repos.summary_en: ieaseMusic is an elegant third-party Netease Music desktop app built with Electron, React, and MobX. It supports cross-platform use (macOS/Linux/Windows), high-quality FLAC audio, keyboard shortcuts, desktop notifications, Last.fm scrobbling, multi-source link fixing (e.g., QQ, Xiami), social sharing, WeChat login, and includes an Alfred 3 workflow for quick access.

repos.description: Redpill Recovery (arpl-i18n)
repos.summary_zh: RR（Redpill Recovery）是一个专为任意 x86/x64 CPU 架构机器打造的 Synology DSM 操作系统自中心化解决方案，支持通过单次刷写引导加载程序实现预安装与恢复环境，适用于本地虚拟化部署。
repos.summary_en: RR (Redpill Recovery) is a self-centralized Synology DSM OS solution for any x86/x64 machine, enabling preinstallation and recovery via a single bootloader flash, ideal for local virtualization deployments.

repos.description: Create stunning demos for free. Open-source, no subscriptions, no watermarks, and free for commercial use. An alternative to Screen Studio.
repos.summary_zh: OpenScreen 是一款免费开源的屏幕录制工具，提供无广告、无订阅、商业可用的屏幕录制与编辑功能，支持自定义缩放、背景、注释及导出设置，适用于制作产品演示和教程视频，是 Screen Studio 的轻量级替代方案。
repos.summary_en: OpenScreen is a free, open-source screen recording tool offering watermark-free, subscription-free recordings with customizable zooms, backgrounds, annotations, and export options. Ideal for product demos and tutorials, it serves as a lightweight alternative to Screen Studio.

repos.description: Open-source KVM software
repos.summary_zh: Input Leap 是一款开源 KVM 软件，模拟传统硬件 KVM 切换器的功能，允许用户通过单一键盘和鼠标控制多台计算机。支持跨系统无缝切换，具备剪贴板共享功能（Linux/Wayland 除外），强调跨平台兼容性（Windows/macOS/Linux/FreeBSD）与用户友好的可靠性设计。
repos.summary_en: Input Leap is an open-source KVM software that mimics hardware KVM switches by enabling a single keyboard and mouse to control multiple computers. It supports seamless screen switching, clipboard sharing (except on Linux/Wayland), and prioritizes cross-platform compatibility (Windows, macOS, Linux, FreeBSD) with a focus on hassle-free reliability and open communication.

repos.description: 截屏 离线OCR 搜索翻译 以图搜图 贴图 录屏 万向滚动截屏 屏幕翻译   Screenshot  Offline OCR   Search   Translate   Search for picture   Paste the picture on the screen   Screen recorder   Omnidirectional scrolling screenshot   Screen translator  支持Windows Linux macOS
repos.summary_zh: eSearch 是一款跨平台屏幕搜索工具，集成截屏、离线OCR、翻译、以图搜图、贴图、录屏和万向滚动截屏功能。基于 Electron 开发，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS，提供高度自定义的 OCR 识别、多引擎翻译及 AI 图像交互能力，适用于高效信息提取与屏幕内容管理。
repos.summary_en: eSearch is a cross-platform screen search tool featuring screenshot, offline OCR, translation, reverse image search, screen overlay, screencasting, and omnidirectional scrolling capture. Built with Electron for Windows, Linux, and macOS, it offers customizable OCR, multi-engine translation, and AI-powered image interaction for efficient content extraction and management.

repos.description: One Remote Access Manager to Rule Them All
repos.summary_zh: 1Remote 是一款现代化的个人远程会话管理与启动工具，支持 RDP、SSH、VNC、Telnet、(S)FTP 等多种协议，提供多屏幕 HiDPI 连接、标签化界面、自定义运行器及 mRemoteNG 导入功能，支持便携运行与多语言主题定制。
repos.summary_en: 1Remote is a modern personal remote session manager and launcher supporting RDP, SSH, VNC, Telnet, (S)FTP, RemoteApp, NoMachine and more. It offers multi-screen HiDPI RDP support, customizable runners, mRemoteNG import, portable deployment, and a tabbed, multi-language interface.

repos.description: "Sigma File Manager" is a free, open-source, quickly evolving, modern file manager (explorer / browser) app for Windows and Linux.
repos.summary_zh: Sigma File Manager 是一款免费开源的现代文件管理器，专为 Windows 和 Linux 设计，支持快速文件浏览与操作。项目已进入 v2 稳定测试阶段，提供直观界面与高效功能，适用于日常文件管理需求。
repos.summary_en: Sigma File Manager is a free, open-source, modern file manager for Windows and Linux, offering fast file browsing and operations. Now in v2 beta, it features an intuitive interface and efficient tools for streamlined file management.

repos.description: An open-source implementation of uTools, a high-performance, scalable application launcher and plugin platform | Supports macOS and Windows, 一个高性能、可扩展的应用启动器和插件平台  uTools 的开源实现 | 支持 macOS 和 Windows
repos.summary_zh: ZTools 是 uTools 的开源实现，一个高性能跨平台应用启动器与插件平台，支持 macOS 和 Windows。采用 Electron + LMDB 数据库架构，具备拼音搜索、正则匹配、剪贴板管理等核心功能，内置插件市场支持在线安装与热更新，提供主题定制与完整 TypeScript API，适用于快速启动应用与自动化工作流。
repos.summary_en: ZTools is an open-source implementation of uTools, a high-performance cross-platform application launcher and plugin platform for macOS and Windows. Built with Electron + LMDB database architecture, it features pinyin search, regex matching, clipboard management, and an integrated plugin market with online installation and auto-updates. Offers theme customization, full TypeScript API support, and seamless app launching/automation workflows.

repos.description: 👻 A simple & beautiful GUI application for scrcpy.
repos.summary_zh: Scrcpy GUI 是一个简洁美观的图形界面应用，用于便捷控制 Android 设备屏幕。它基于 scrcpy 实现，支持 USB 和无线连接、实时屏幕镜像、键盘鼠标控制、多设备管理、剪贴板共享等功能，无需 Root，跨平台运行，提升手机操作效率。
repos.summary_en: Scrcpy GUI is a simple and beautiful graphical application for controlling Android devices via scrcpy. It supports USB and wireless connections, real-time screen mirroring, keyboard/mouse input, multi-device management, clipboard sharing, and more—without requiring root access. It enhances mobile productivity across Windows, macOS, and Linux.

repos.description: Enable Apple Intelligence on Macs sold in Mainland China with SIP enabled, tested on MacOS 15.4.1+ and 26+
repos.summary_zh: 本工具通过修改系统缓存文件及注入eligibiltyd进程，绕过Apple对Apple Intelligence在中国销售Mac上的区域限制，支持macOS 15.4+及26.1+，无需常驻后台服务。提供方法1（lldb注入+文件锁定）和方法2（直接修改plist）两种方案，新增强制修改地区为美国功能以解锁ChatGPT整合等高级特性，适用于M1及以上芯片设备。
repos.summary_en: This tool enables Apple Intelligence on Macs sold in Mainland China by bypassing regional restrictions via system cache modification and eligibilityd process injection, tested on macOS 15.4+ and 26.1+. It requires no persistent background services and offers two methods: Method 1 (lldb injection + file locking) and Method 2 (direct plist editing), with an added option to force region change to US for advanced features like ChatGPT integration, compatible with M1+ chips.

repos.description: Experimental
repos.summary_zh: Box 是一个实验性项目，核心功能为通过修改 App.java 配置文件调整应用默认设置，包括播放类型、解码方式、历史记录数量等参数。
repos.summary_en: Box is an experimental project focused on configuring default app settings via App.java, including playback type, decoding mode, DNS, and UI preferences.

repos.description: macOS Adobe apps download & installer
repos.summary_zh: Adobe Downloader 是一款专为 macOS 设计的 Adobe 应用程序下载与安装工具，支持多产品并行下载、版本与语言选择，并集成自动化安装与清理功能。通过内置 Helper 机制实现免密操作，无需用户干预即可完成 Setup 组件修改，确保合法官方渠道下载，适用于专业创意软件部署。
repos.summary_en: Adobe Downloader is a macOS-native tool for downloading and installing Adobe applications. It supports parallel downloads, version/language selection, and automated installation via a built-in Helper mechanism that eliminates password prompts. All downloads are from official Adobe sources, with full cleanup utilities for residual files, ideal for enterprise or personal use.

repos.description: An unofficial 12306 Client for Mac
repos.summary_zh: 12306ForMac 是一款非官方的 Mac 版 12306 火车票订票助手，支持自动捡票与下单功能。基于 Swift 开发，依赖 Carthage 管理 CocoaPods 依赖，兼容 OS X 10.11 及以上系统。项目采用 Alamofire、PromiseKit 等主流框架，提供图形化界面替代官方网页购票，适用于 macOS 用户便捷购票。
repos.summary_en: 12306ForMac is an unofficial macOS client for 12306 railway ticket booking, supporting auto-search and purchasing. Built with Swift 3.2 and Xcode 9.0, it uses Carthage for dependency management and integrates Alamofire, PromiseKit, and FMDB. Designed for OS X 10.11+, it offers a native GUI alternative to the official web interface for convenient ticket booking.

repos.description: A command line tool for upgrading every outdated app installed by Homebrew Cask
repos.summary_zh: brew-cask-upgrade 是一个命令行工具，用于升级通过 Homebrew Cask 安装的过时 macOS GUI 应用。它提供交互式界面、细粒度控制及自动更新检测，支持批量升级、排除自动更新应用、清理缓存等功能，是 Homebrew Cask 生态中提升应用管理效率的关键工具。
repos.summary_en: brew-cask-upgrade is a CLI tool to upgrade outdated macOS GUI apps installed via Homebrew Cask. It offers interactive prompts, granular control, auto-update detection, batch upgrades, and features like cleanup and quarantine bypass, enhancing the efficiency of managing Homebrew Cask applications.

repos.description: Elegant Microsoft To-Do desktop app
repos.summary_zh: Ao 是一款优雅的开源 Microsoft To-Do 桌面应用，支持深色/黑色/琥珀色主题、紧凑模式、全局快捷键、列表导航及跨平台使用，覆盖 120 余国用户，提供高度可定制界面与自动夜间模式，通过 GitHub Sponsors 获得社区支持。
repos.summary_en: Ao is an elegant, unofficial, open-source Microsoft To-Do desktop app used globally, featuring dark themes, compact mode, global shortcuts, list navigation, scalable UI, and auto-night mode, with community-driven development and support via GitHub Sponsors.

repos.description: Elasticsearch权威指南中文版
repos.summary_zh: 《Elasticsearch权威指南》中文版由Looly团队主导翻译，系统解析Elasticsearch核心原理与高级特性，涵盖索引设计、查询优化、集群管理等关键技术点，是深入掌握Elasticsearch的权威学习资料，支持多平台阅读。
repos.summary_en: The Chinese translation of 'Elasticsearch: The Definitive Guide', led by Looly, provides a comprehensive deep-dive into Elasticsearch's core concepts, including indexing, advanced querying, and cluster management. It serves as an authoritative resource for mastering Elasticsearch's advanced features and internal mechanisms.

repos.description: Modern mouse gestures for Windows. (C#)
repos.summary_zh: WGestures 是一款现代化的 Windows 全局鼠标手势工具，支持 Win7/8/10，提供直观的手势操作以提升效率。采用 C# 开发，集成数字签名与安装程序，适用于快速执行系统命令或应用操作。
repos.summary_en: WGestures is a modern global mouse gesture tool for Windows (Win7/8/10), enabling efficient navigation via intuitive gestures. Built in C# with digital signing and MSI installer support, it streamlines workflow automation through customizable gesture actions.

repos.description: Power Keys - 解放 Windows 和 macOS 使用效率
repos.summary_zh: Power Keys 是一款专为 Windows 和 macOS 设计的效率工具，通过精心设计的无冲突快捷键组合，显著提升系统操作效率。其核心价值在于统一跨平台快捷键逻辑，降低学习成本，适用于日常办公、开发及多任务处理场景。
repos.summary_en: Power Keys is an efficiency tool for Windows and macOS that boosts productivity through well-designed, non-conflicting keyboard shortcuts. It unifies cross-platform shortcut logic, reducing learning curves for developers and power users in daily workflows and multitasking.

repos.description: 高颜值的第三方网易云播放器；支持流媒体音乐，如navidrome、jellyfin、emby；支持本地音乐播放、离线歌单、逐字歌词、桌面歌词、Touch Bar歌词、Mac状态栏歌词显示、Linux-gnome与Linux-kde桌面状态栏歌词显示；支持降调降速，支持自定义主题等。支持 Windows / macOS / Linux :electron:
repos.summary_zh: VutronMusic 是一款高颜值跨平台第三方网易云音乐播放器，支持本地音乐、流媒体服务（如Navidrome、Jellyfin）、离线歌单及逐字歌词。具备桌面歌词、状态栏歌词、变调变速、自定义主题等功能，采用 Vue3 + TypeScript + Fastify 架构，支持 Windows/macOS/Linux 多平台。
repos.summary_en: VutronMusic is a high-end third-party NetEase Cloud Music player supporting local music, streaming services (Navidrome, Jellyfin), offline playlists, and karaoke-style lyrics. Features include desktop lyrics, system tray display, pitch/speed control, custom themes, and advanced audio effects. Built with Vue3, TypeScript, Fastify, and Electron for cross-platform support.

repos.description: elasticsearch 权威指南
repos.summary_zh: 《Elasticsearch 权威指南》中文版项目，由译者 Gavin Foo 翻译自 Clinton Gormley 和 Zachary Tong 的原作，涵盖 Elasticsearch 的核心概念、全文搜索、结构化查询、数据分析、地理定位、自动补全等高级功能，并提供生产环境配置与监控实践，适合开发者与数据工程师系统学习 Elasticsearch。
repos.summary_en: The Chinese translation of 'Elasticsearch: The Definitive Guide' by Gavin Foo, based on the original work by Clinton Gormley and Zachary Tong. This project covers core concepts, full-text search, structured queries, analytics, geolocation, autocomplete, and production deployment of Elasticsearch, serving as a comprehensive resource for developers and data engineers.

repos.description: 🎯 精选 RSSHub 实用路由推荐，让你的 RSS 阅读更高效！
repos.summary_zh: 精选高质量 RSSHub 路由与官方 RSS 源，涵盖 AI、科技媒体、安全、前端开发等垂直领域，提供一键导入 OPML 文件功能，支持在线搜索分类浏览，显著提升 RSS 阅读效率。
repos.summary_en: Curated high-quality RSS feeds and RSSHub routes covering AI, tech media, security, frontend development, etc., with one-click OPML import, online search and categorization for efficient RSS reading.

repos.description: This is a Opensource Live wallpaper solution for MacOS
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个为 macOS 14+ 设计的开源动态壁纸应用，支持 MP4 和 MOV 视频格式，具备多显示器支持与高性能渲染。用户可通过 Homebrew 或源码编译安装，需注意绕过 Gatekeeper 安全限制。项目计划将 Objective-C++ UI 迁移至 SwiftUI，但守护进程保持不变。
repos.summary_en: An open-source live wallpaper app for macOS 14+, supporting MP4/MOV video playback with multi-display rendering and high performance. Install via Homebrew or compile from source using Xcode and CMake. Requires Gatekeeper bypass for unsigned apps. UI modernization to SwiftUI is planned while maintaining the daemon component.

repos.description: A native macOS system toolkit: honest memory optimization, deep cleanup that finds the real space hogs, fan control, keep-awake, disk analyzer.
repos.summary_zh: 生成失败
repos.summary_en: Generation failed

repos.description: Complexity within, simplicity without. 繁于内，简于形。
repos.summary_zh: ClawDeckX 是为 OpenClaw 设计的开源可视化管理平台，提供 macOS 级视觉体验与极简操作界面。支持多语言、跨平台部署，具备实时监控、智能场景模板、技能中心等功能，显著降低 AI 代理的配置门槛，适合初学者快速上手。
repos.summary_en: ClawDeckX is an open-source web visual management platform for OpenClaw, offering a macOS-grade interface with glassmorphism design and smooth animations. It simplifies AI agent configuration through guided wizards, real-time monitoring, multi-agent workflows, and cross-platform deployment (Windows/macOS/Linux), ideal for beginners and advanced users alike.

repos.description: 设计模式的python实现
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是设计模式在 Python3 中的完整实现，涵盖创建型、结构型与行为型三大类共23种经典模式，提供清晰代码示例与参考链接，适合学习设计模式与提升架构设计能力。
repos.summary_en: This repository implements 23 classic design patterns in Python3, covering Creational, Structural, and Behavioral categories with clear examples and references, ideal for learning design patterns and improving software architecture skills.

repos.description: ProxyLLM是一款本地 Electron 应用，通过捕获浏览器会话把多种 LLM网站的能力统一为 OpenAI 兼容 API, 一键应用到Claude Code (ProxyLLM is a local Electron application that captures browser sessions to unify the capabilities of multiple LLM websites into an OpenAI-compatible API, enabling one-click integration with Claude Code)
repos.summary_zh: ProxyLLM 是一款本地 Electron 应用，通过捕获浏览器会话将 Claude、OpenAI、Gemini 等多平台 LLM 服务统一为 OpenAI 兼容 API，支持一键集成 Claude Code。具备多站点管理、凭据自动捕获、OAuth 登录、动态模型发现及本地持久化日志等功能，提供完整的 OpenAI 格式接口与 Anthropic 原生 API 支持。
repos.summary_en: ProxyLLM is a local Electron application that unifies multiple LLM platforms (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini) into an OpenAI-compatible API by capturing browser sessions. It enables one-click integration with Claude Code, featuring multi-site management, automatic credential capture, OAuth login, dynamic model discovery, and local persistence, exposing both OpenAI-style and native Anthropic APIs.

repos.description: 使用任何设备(浏览器)作为mac的副屏(随航) 将Android平板用作Mac的第二台显示器 还能在Win和Linux镜像屏幕
repos.summary_zh: 咩Display 是一款跨平台屏幕镜像工具，支持将任意带浏览器的设备（如 Android 平板）作为 Mac 的副屏，实现类似 Apple 随航的功能。基于 ffmpeg 实时转码，支持 mjpg、vp8、h264、hevc 多种编码，延迟低至 100ms（mjpg 模式），适用于 Windows/Linux 屏幕镜像。内置自动旋转、全屏切换，支持通过 ADB 实现 Android 有线连接，适合多屏办公与移动场景。
repos.summary_en: meDisplay is a cross-platform screen mirroring tool that turns any browser-equipped device (e.g., Android tablet) into a secondary display for Mac, mimicking Apple's Sidecar. Built with real-time ffmpeg transcoding, it supports mjpg, vp8, h264, and hevc encoding with ultra-low latency (as low as 100ms in mjpg mode). Also supports Windows/Linux X11 mirroring, auto-rotation, fullscreen toggle, and ADB-based Android wired connection for seamless multi-screen workflows.

repos.description: Browser-Use Desktop app, control your local Chrome browser with AI agents!
repos.summary_zh: Browser-Use Desktop 是一款基于 Electron 和 Gradio 的桌面应用，通过 AI 智能体控制本地 Chrome 浏览器，实现网页自动化操作。支持多模态 LLM（如 OpenAI、Google、Anthropic 等）和自定义浏览器配置，无需重新登录网站，支持高清屏幕录制，适用于网页抓取、自动化测试等场景。
repos.summary_en: Browser-Use Desktop is an Electron-based desktop app that enables AI agents to control your local Chrome browser via Gradio UI. It supports multiple LLMs (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, etc.), custom browser profiles, and high-definition screen recording, eliminating re-authentication issues and ideal for web automation and scraping tasks.

repos.description: Nothing, just a simple ssh tool.
repos.summary_zh: mmh 是一个轻量级 SSH 管理工具，提供便捷的远程主机连接与命令执行功能，适合运维场景下的快速访问。支持配置管理与批量操作，界面简洁，适合日常使用。
repos.summary_en: mmh is a lightweight SSH management tool designed for quick remote host access and command execution. It supports configuration management and batch operations, featuring a simple interface ideal for routine system administration tasks.

repos.description: 🚀 UniHub - 现代化的跨平台工具集应用，支持强大的插件系统 | Modern cross-platform toolkit with powerful plugin system
repos.summary_zh: UniHub 是基于 Electron 的现代化跨平台工具集应用，采用 Vue 3 + TypeScript + Vite 技术栈，配备强大的插件系统和内置插件市场。支持动态插件加载、细粒度权限管理、自动更新检测等功能，提供优雅的 Tailwind CSS 界面和全局快捷键操作体验。
repos.summary_en: UniHub is a modern cross-platform toolkit built with Electron, Vue 3, TypeScript, and Vite. It features a powerful plugin system with dynamic loading, granular permission control, built-in marketplace, and automatic update detection. The app offers an elegant UI powered by Tailwind CSS and global keyboard shortcuts for enhanced productivity.

repos.description: A declarative, SwiftUI-like framework for building Terminal User Interfaces in Swift.
repos.summary_zh: TUIkit 是一个 SwiftUI 风格的终端用户界面框架，提供纯 Swift 实现的声明式 TUI 开发体验。支持状态管理、布局容器、交互组件和完整样式系统，无需 ncurses 或 C 依赖，适用于 macOS 和 Linux 平台。
repos.summary_en: TUIkit is a SwiftUI-like framework for building Terminal User Interfaces in pure Swift, offering declarative syntax with state management, layout containers, interactive components, and full styling support without ncurses or C dependencies.

repos.description: Desktop operations console for CPA-managed Codex auth pools.
repos.summary_zh: CPA控制中心是一款专为管理Codex授权池设计的桌面运维工具，基于Wails框架构建，集成Go、Vue 3与TypeScript。它通过Base URL和Management Token连接CPA实例，提供库存同步、扫描维护、任务调度、日志查看及CSV/JSON导出等功能，支持中英文双语界面，适用于大规模授权池的统一健康监控与自动化运维。
repos.summary_en: CPA Control Center is a desktop operations tool for managing Codex auth pools via CPA, built with Wails using Go, Vue 3, and TypeScript. It connects to a CPA instance via Base URL and Management Token, enabling inventory sync, scanning, maintenance, scheduling, logs, history tracking, and CSV/JSON exports. Designed for large-scale pools, it offers real-time health monitoring, bilingual UI (English/Chinese), and automated quota refresh.

repos.description: This is a powerful window visualization design project designed to meet the needs of multiple platforms, including Windows, macOS, and Linux.
repos.summary_zh: GoEasyDesigner 是一款基于 Go 语言和 Wails 框架开发的跨平台可视化窗口设计工具，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。提供直观的拖拽式界面设计、智能代码编辑、中文函数库支持及自定义组件开发功能，内置丰富的 UI 控件库（按钮、表格、树形组件等），集成一键环境配置与多语言支持，适用于快速构建桌面应用原型。
repos.summary_en: GoEasyDesigner is a cross-platform visual window design tool built with Go and the Wails framework, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. It offers drag-and-drop UI design, intelligent code editing, Chinese function library support, custom component creation, and a rich set of UI controls (buttons, tables, tree components, etc.), along with one-click environment setup and multilingual capabilities for rapid desktop app prototyping.

repos.description: Change default search engine to OAIFree search(shared).
repos.summary_zh: OAIFree Search(Shared) 是一个 Chrome 浏览器插件，允许用户直接在地址栏使用 OAIFree 共享搜索功能。通过替换默认搜索引擎，实现快速访问 AI 驱动的搜索服务，适用于需要高效检索信息的用户场景。
repos.summary_en: OAIFree Search(Shared) is a Chrome extension enabling direct address bar searches via the OAIFree shared search engine. It replaces the default search provider for instant access to AI-powered search, ideal for users requiring fast information retrieval.

repos.summary_zh: Kiro Manager 是一款跨平台桌面应用，基于 Wails + Vue 3 构建，专用于 Kiro IDE 账号管理、Machine ID 备份恢复与自动切换。支持多账号切换、Token 自动刷新、批量操作及智能环境快照切换，具备低余额预警、进程检测和无感切号等核心功能，显著提升开发者在多订阅环境下的使用效率。
repos.summary_en: Kiro Manager is a cross-platform desktop application built with Wails and Vue 3, designed for managing Kiro IDE accounts, Machine ID backup/restore, and automated environment switching. It supports multi-account management, token auto-refresh, batch operations, low-balance alerts, process detection, and seamless snapshot switching—enhancing developer productivity across subscription tiers.

repos.description: Rime 词库及配置
repos.summary_zh: Rime 输入法跨平台配置文件集合，涵盖 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 系统下的词库与配置扩展，支持自定义快捷键、候选栏、输入方案及外观样式，提供 luna_pinyin 扩展词库与个性化定制模板，适用于高效中文输入与本地化部署。
repos.summary_en: A comprehensive collection of Rime input method configurations for Windows, macOS, and Linux, including custom dictionaries, input scheme definitions, candidate display settings, and UI styling. Features extended pinyin dictionaries and user-customizable templates for personalized Chinese input experience.

repos.description: A free macOS native app to remove image backgrounds locally
repos.summary_zh: Figura 是一款免费的 macOS 原生应用，利用系统 Vision 框架实现本地快速背景去除，支持拖拽、粘贴或点击上传，界面简洁现代，兼容深色/浅色模式，专为 macOS 14+ 设计。
repos.summary_en: Figura is a free native macOS app that leverages the system's Vision framework for fast, local background removal. It supports drag-and-drop, paste (⌘V), or click upload, features a minimalist SwiftUI interface, and works on macOS 14+ with dark/light mode support.

repos.description: ToMic - Turn Your Phone into a PC Microphone
repos.summary_zh: ToMic 是一款基于 Web 技术的局域网虚拟麦克风工具，可将手机浏览器作为电脑的麦克风输入源。通过 Wi-Fi 传输音频流，并利用虚拟声卡（如 BlackHole 或 VB-CABLE）实现低延迟音频路由，适用于 Zoom、Teams、Discord 等会议场景，无需安装 App，支持 macOS 和 Windows 平台。
repos.summary_en: ToMic is a Web-based LAN virtual microphone tool that turns your phone into a PC microphone via browser. It streams audio over Wi-Fi using WebSocket and Opus encoding, then routes it through virtual sound cards (e.g., BlackHole or VB-CABLE) for low-latency input in apps like Zoom, Teams, or Discord. No app installation required on mobile, with native support for macOS and Windows.

repos.description: 让你的AI摆脱浏览器的束缚
repos.summary_zh: ChatFree 是一款基于 Python 开发的桌面 AI 辅助工具，支持多模型接入与智能文本补全，通过系统代理自动识别和快捷键操作，让用户摆脱浏览器限制，实现全局 AI 对话与写作增强。
repos.summary_en: ChatFree is a desktop AI assistant built with Python, offering multi-model support and intelligent text completion. It enables global AI interaction via system proxy detection and hotkeys, freeing users from browser constraints for enhanced writing and conversation.

repos.description: Rime 输入法跨平台可视化配置工具，支持 macOS（鼠须管）和 Windows（小狼毫），无需手动编辑 YAML，通过直观的图形界面管理所有配置。

repos.description: 一款go语言开发的翻译软件 适用于 macos
repos.summary_zh: 一款基于Go语言和Wails框架开发的跨平台翻译软件，专为macOS设计。支持苹果系统翻译及百度、彩云小译、有道、火山、腾讯、阿里云、DeepL、OpenAI等10+主流翻译服务，提供划词和截屏翻译功能，需配置辅助权限。项目采用GPL-3.0协议开源，已完成macOS应用打包，未来计划扩展Windows版本与插件化接口。
repos.summary_en: A cross-platform translation software built with Go and Wails framework, optimized for macOS. Supports Apple System Translation and 10+ services including Baidu, Caiyun, Youdao, Volcengine, Tencent, Alibaba Cloud, DeepL, and OpenAI. Features word selection and screenshot translation with accessibility permissions required. Released as GPL-3.0 open-source, with macOS app packaged; future plans include Windows version and plugin interface.

repos.description: Cross-platform desktop wrapper for TUIStudio (Wails v2 + Go)
repos.summary_zh: TUIStudio Desktop 是基于 Wails v2（Go + WebView）构建的跨平台桌面应用，为 TUIStudio 提供原生 GUI 支持。支持 macOS (.dmg)、Windows (.exe) 和 Linux (.deb) 多平台发布，体积小巧（约8MB），通过 Go 与前端 Vite 热重载集成实现高效开发流程，适用于 TUI 界面可视化设计场景。
repos.summary_en: TUIStudio Desktop is a cross-platform desktop wrapper for TUIStudio, built with Wails v2 (Go + WebView). It packages as lightweight installers: .dmg (~8 MB), NSIS .exe, and .deb. Features hot-reload dev workflow via Vite and Go IPC bridge, enabling native file dialogs and seamless integration for TUI design tools.

repos.description: A Flask-based tool that types or copies text from mobile devices directly to Windows computers.
repos.summary_zh: EasyType 是一款基于 Flask 的跨平台输入工具，支持手机实时输入内容并直接推送到 Windows 剪贴板或模拟键盘输入，具备低延迟同步、移动端优化界面和多种快捷键支持，适用于远程办公与高效输入场景。
repos.summary_en: EasyType is a Flask-based tool enabling real-time text input from mobile devices to Windows via clipboard or direct keyboard simulation, featuring low-latency sync, mobile-optimized UI, and shortcut support for remote typing and clipboard sharing.

repos.description: Professional SEO and GEO audit workflows for brands, SaaS teams, SEO operators, agencies, and AI-search growth teams.
repos.summary_zh: SEO GEO Audit 是一个统一的审计框架，专为品牌、SaaS团队、SEO运营者、代理机构和AI搜索增长团队设计。它将技术健康度、内容质量、信任背书、外部平台可见性及AI适配性整合为可执行的决策体系，帮助判断网站是否真正具备在搜索引擎和AI驱动发现中获胜的能力。
repos.summary_en: SEO GEO Audit is a unified audit framework for teams needing more than technical SEO checks. It evaluates whether a website is technically sound, structurally clear, trustworthy, AI-ready, externally visible, and aligned across platforms—turning fragmented findings into a prioritized executive decision system.
